title: 🔥 THE AUTHORITY OF JESUS – EVERY KNEE WILL BOW! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE AUTHORITY OF JESUS – EVERY KNEE WILL BOW! 🔥
📖 Matthew 28:18 – "Then Jesus came to them and said, ‘All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.’"

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, I know Jesus is powerful, but what does it mean when the Bible says He has ALL authority? Does that mean He rules over everything? Even demons? And what does that mean for us as believers?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people recognize Jesus as a great teacher, a miracle worker, or even a prophet. But the Bible makes one thing crystal clear—JESUS CHRIST HAS ABSOLUTE, SUPREME AUTHORITY OVER ALL CREATION!
🚨 Let’s dive deep into the truth of Jesus’ authority and what it means for us today!

🔥 1. JESUS HAS AUTHORITY OVER HEAVEN AND EARTH
📖 Colossians 1:16-17 – "For in Him all things were created: things in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or powers or rulers or authorities; all things have been created through Him and for Him. He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together."
🔥 JESUS IS NOT JUST A TEACHER—HE IS THE CREATOR AND SUSTAINER OF EVERYTHING!

✔️ The universe exists because of Him.
✔️ Every kingdom, government, and power is under Him.
✔️ Even time itself is held together by His will!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Think about the power of a king or a president—they rule nations. But Jesus?
👉 He rules over the ENTIRE UNIVERSE!
🚨 JESUS IS THE SUPREME KING—NOTHING IS ABOVE HIM!

🔥 2. JESUS HAS AUTHORITY OVER DEMONS AND HELL
📖 Luke 10:17 – "The seventy-two returned with joy and said, ‘Lord, even the demons submit to us in Your name!’"
🔥 SATAN AND HIS DEMONS TREMBLE AT THE NAME OF JESUS!

✔️ Every demon is under His control.
✔️ Hell is not Satan’s kingdom—it is his punishment! (Revelation 20:10)
✔️ Even death itself bows before Jesus! (Revelation 1:18)

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
When Jesus encountered legions of demons in a possessed man, they BEGGED Him for mercy! (Mark 5:6-13)
👉 Demons don’t argue with Jesus—they OBEY Him because His authority is absolute!
🚨 NO DEMON CAN STAND AGAINST JESUS’ POWER!

🔥 3. JESUS HAS AUTHORITY TO FORGIVE SINS
📖 Mark 2:10 – "But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins."
🔥 ONLY JESUS CAN ERASE SIN AND GIVE ETERNAL LIFE!

✔️ No priest, no pastor, no church can forgive sins—ONLY JESUS CAN!
✔️ His sacrifice on the cross PAID the full price of our sins.
✔️ Without His authority, no one could be saved!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A man on death row has no hope—until the highest judge gives him a full pardon.
👉 Jesus is the ONLY ONE who has the authority to pardon our sins!
🚨 WITHOUT JESUS, THERE IS NO FORGIVENESS!

🔥 4. JESUS HAS AUTHORITY OVER SICKNESS AND DEATH
📖 Matthew 8:16 – "He drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the sick."
🔥 WHEN JESUS SPEAKS, DISEASE AND DEATH BOW DOWN!

✔️ He healed the blind, the lame, and the lepers.
✔️ He raised the dead—including Lazarus, who was dead for 4 days! (John 11:43-44)
✔️ Even the wind and the waves obeyed Him! (Mark 4:39)

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Doctors have authority over medicine, but sometimes, even they can’t save a life.
👉 Jesus has authority over life itself—He can heal ANYTHING!
🚨 SICKNESS AND DEATH HAVE NO POWER OVER JESUS!

🔥 5. JESUS HAS AUTHORITY TO JUDGE THE WORLD
📖 John 5:22 – "Moreover, the Father judges no one, but has entrusted all judgment to the Son."
🔥 JESUS IS NOT JUST A SAVIOR—HE IS ALSO THE FINAL JUDGE!

✔️ Every human will stand before Him on Judgment Day. (Revelation 20:11-12)
✔️ He will separate the saved from the lost. (Matthew 25:31-33)
✔️ If your name is not in His Book of Life, you will be condemned.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
In a courtroom, the judge makes the final decision—guilty or innocent.
👉 On Judgment Day, JESUS will decide your eternal fate!
🚨 YOU CAN’T AVOID HIS JUDGMENT—CHOOSE HIM NOW!

🔥 6. JESUS GIVES HIS AUTHORITY TO BELIEVERS!
📖 Luke 10:19 – "I have given you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and to overcome all the power of the enemy; nothing will harm you."
🔥 AS FOLLOWERS OF JESUS, WE WALK IN HIS AUTHORITY!

✔️ We have authority over demons in Jesus’ name.
✔️ We can pray for the sick and see healing.
✔️ We have victory over sin through His power!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A police officer has no power on his own—but when he carries the government’s authority, criminals obey.
👉 As Christians, we have JESUS’ authority backing us!
🚨 WALK IN THE AUTHORITY JESUS GAVE YOU!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: EVERY KNEE WILL BOW TO JESUS!
📖 Philippians 2:9-11 – "Therefore God exalted Him to the highest place and gave Him the name that is above every name, that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth, and every tongue acknowledge that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father."
🚨 EVERYONE WILL BOW BEFORE JESUS—BELIEVERS AND UNBELIEVERS!

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU DO?
❌ Ignore His authority and face eternal judgment?
✔️ Submit to Him now and receive eternal life?

👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
✔️ Follow Jesus and walk in His authority?
❌ Or reject Him and be condemned?
🚨 CHOOSE WISELY—YOUR ETERNITY DEPENDS ON IT!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO SUBMIT TO JESUS’ AUTHORITY
"Lord Jesus, I acknowledge You as the King of kings and the Lord of lords. I submit to Your authority over my life. Forgive my sins and give me the power to walk in Your truth. I surrender everything to You. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
